user.title: CasaZapp TV
user.description: Make an API key on the server under Settings → Account → API keys. A read-only key shows what plays and the recordings; a key that may also control plans and stops recordings and stops streams.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {url} no longer works. Make a new one under Settings → Account → API keys.

error.invalid_auth: This API key is not valid, or it was revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the server at this address.

record.name: Record
record.description: Plans a recording: now for some minutes, or from a start to a stop.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one server.

channel_id.name: Channel
channel_id.description: The channel's number on the server (see the API page).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Record now for this long. Default 60.

start.name: Start
start.description: Record later: from this time (with Stop).

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Record later: until this time (with Start).

title.name: Title
title.description: Without one, the programme from the guide names it.

takeover.name: Take over
takeover.description: Start even when it stops someone watching.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops a recording that runs; what was recorded stays.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one server.

delete_recording.name: Remove recording
delete_recording.description: Cancels a planned recording, or deletes a recorded one.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one server.

stop_stream.name: Stop stream
stop_stream.description: Stops what a device watches; it sees that this key stopped it.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one server.

stream_id.name: Stream
stream_id.description: The id from the Watching sensor or a media player.

which_server.message: There is more than one CasaZapp TV server: choose one.

no_server.message: That CasaZapp TV server isn't loaded.

forbidden.message: This API key, or its profile, may not do this.

start_and_stop.message: Give both a start and a stop, or neither.
